answer_1.quote: We propose a novel dataset SC-ITAB, which fulfills these stated criteria. It contains 1,225 challenging scientific claims, each demanding compositional reasoning for verification using scientific tables.
answer_1.outputs: scientific claims, refuted claims, unverifiable claims

answer_2.quote: We report the Macro-F 1 scores at the bottom of Table 4.

answer_4.quote: To examine how humans perform on our SCITAB dataset, we hired an annotator from our candidate annotators pool, following the same training procedure as other annotators.
answer_4.guideline: We ask each annotator to fill in a questionnaire, including their age, department, maximum workload per week, etc. After that, we provide a training session to ensure they understand the task and can use the annotation interfaces (Appendix B.2 and B.3). We also give them three samples to test their understanding.
